title.justification: Title as given on the first page
title.value: Artificial Neural Networks for Magnetoencephalography: A Review of an Emerging Field

extractions.description: A topical literature review surveying 119 studies that apply artificial neural networks to magnetoencephalography (MEG) data, categorised into 'Classification', 'Modeling' and 'Other' (preprocessing, source localization, methods). The paper summarises architectures, datasets, preprocessing, validation strategies and limitations; it performs no experiments or computational runs of its own.

type.quote: This topical review included studies that applied ANNs to MEG data.
type.justification: It is a survey/review summarising empirical studies, with quantitative descriptive statistics about the corpus; no theory is developed.
